name: Life360
clauses: This Life360 Privacy Policy (“Privacy Policy”) was last modified on Aug 26, 2026. Life360 protects and connects your loved ones, pets, and important items to make your life easier and less stressful. We take your privacy as seriously as you do, and we are committed to protecting it. This Privacy Policy explains our practices regarding the collection, use, disclosure, transfer, storage, and protection of personal information that is collected through our products and services, as well as your choices regarding the same.

As you review our Privacy Policy, keep in mind that it applies to Life360, Inc.’s ("Life360", "we", "our", or "us") websites (for Life360 and Jiobit, collectively, “Websites”), mobile and watch apps, help center, and other associated services we provide (“Services”). It also applies to Life360 physical devices (e.g., Life360 Pet GPS, Tile trackers, Life360 Pet Tag ("Pet Tag"), and partner products that have the Tile-finding technology embedded within them) as well as other products such as Labels (“Products”).

Before accessing or using our Products and/or Services, please ensure that you have read this Privacy Policy and understand how we collect, store, use, and disclose your personal information as described herein. If you are using our Life360 mobile/watch app through a membership offered to you as part of an employee benefit program offered by your employer ("Employee Benefit Program Members"), then the following sections of this Privacy Policy do not apply to your use of our Life360 mobile/watch app: Section III. Advertising Activities; Section IV.E.

Disclosure of Information to Business Partners for their Own Use; and Section V.B. Controlling Aggregate Insights. This Life360 Privacy Policy does not cover personal information that our Life360 Ads Featuring Nativo division (“Life360 Ads Featuring Nativo”) collects and uses when you visit the websites or mobile apps of publisher and advertiser clients of Life360 Ads Featuring Nativo – this information can be found in our Life360 Ads by Nativo Consumer Privacy Policy.

The Life360 Privacy Policy also does not cover personal information that Life360 Ads Featuring Nativo collects and uses from visitors to the Life360 Ads Featuring Nativo website and from its advertising and publishing customers’ representatives - this information can be found in our Life360 Ads Featuring Nativo Website Privacy Policy.
INFORMATION WE COLLECT: The information Life360 collects depends on what Life360 Products or Services you use and how you use them.

Information You Give Us Directly: When you create or modify a Life360, Tile, or Jiobit account, update your preferences, purchase and/or activate a Product, contact us (including by social media or via our Help Center), participate in an online survey, or otherwise interact with Life360’s Products and Services, we may collect a variety of information, including: Account Information. When you create an account with us, your username, email address, real name, nicknames, date of birth, mobile/watch phone number, password, shipping and billing addresses, and Products activated.

You may also choose to provide a photo to associate with your Life360 account, Pet GPS, Tile, Pet Tag, or Jiobit Products. Managed Accounts: For Managed accounts, we collect your status as a manager or a managed member and the association between the accounts.

Circle Information. When you create a Circle in your Life360 app and invite a friend or family member to join your Circle, we collect their name, email address, mobile/watch phone number, and photo if one is provided. Your friend or family member may also provide us with this information directly when they invite you to join their circle.

Identity Verification. In certain circumstances, for instance, depending on the features of our Products and Services you use or based on your age and country of residence, we may take steps to verify that a parent or guardian has consented to use of the Services by a child. We work with an identity verification vendor that may collect information from or an image of a government-issued ID or an image of you (for example, a selfie), which may be used with facial recognition technology.

(Note: the digital age of consent may vary by jurisdiction and Life360 may adjust our parental consent process accordingly. For more information, please click here. Transaction Information. When you place an order for a Product or upgrade to a premium subscription, you will need to provide an email address, a first and last name and/or a shipping address. Any payment information you provide is processed by the relevant billing and/or payment processor.

We may also collect information such as which version of the Product or subscription service you are using, the date and time that you activated your account, the duration of your subscription, the data related to any subscription cancellation request, and any in-app purchases you may make.

Optional Account Information. We may collect information when you customize features within our Products or Services (for example, labeling locations on your in-app map within Life360, using "Smart Alert" for a Pet GPS or Tile device, or providing emergency information about the wearer of a Pet GPS or Jiobit device, such as their, height, weight, gender, ethnicity, race, medications, allergies, and medical conditions including whether the individual is special needs and the category of such special needs, or pet breed in the case of an animal).

If you choose to create a pet profile, you and Circle members may share information related to your pet and its routine. Contest prize and Tax information: If you are the recipient of a contest or sweepstakes prize that requires tax reporting, we may collect identifiers associated with your government-issued documents (such as a social security number).

Feedback and Social Interactions with Us. We collect information when you provide Life360 with feedback or otherwise interact with us, such as when you leave a review on our website, comment on a blog post, or when you tag Life360, Tile, or Jiobit on a social media post.

Other Information You Provide to Us. We collect information you provide in response to surveys about our Products or Services, any information about your friends that you provide us, such as when you purchase a gift subscription, and information you provide when seeking help from us, such as your name, email address, telephone number, mailing address and records (including call recordings) and technical information related to the issues you experience.

Information We Collect Automatically When You Use or Interact with our Products and Services: We and our service providers may collect other information when you use our Products and Services, such as: Device Information. This includes information about your device, hardware and software information, such as your mobile/watch device identifiers, operating system, IP address, or browser information (including browser type and language preference), device make/model, Wi-Fi connection, battery status, and advertising identifiers.

Location and Movement Information. With your consent, we collect precise geolocation data (including GPS coordinates, latitude/longitude information, and motion sensor information) through your mobile/watch device or our Products that transmit precise geolocation data. Separately, if you are a member or non-member that finds a Tile, Pet GPS, or Pet Tag, you may submit location information about where you are located, or where you found the item and/or your personal contact information.

We also collect information about your location such as city or zip code inferred through your IP address and information through technologies like Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Driving Event Information and Motion Activity Information. This information includes information about how and where you are moving such as your speed, altitude, estimated number of steps and/or distance covered, and heading, and is collected from technology embedded in your mobile/watch device or our Products, such as gyroscope, accelerometer, compass, cellular and Bluetooth.

This information indicates things like whether you (or a pet) are moving and if so, how you or your pet are moving (i.e., are you cycling, walking, running, or driving (etc.), how fast you are going, and whether you are speeding up or slowing down).

Information Collected via Tracking Technologies. When you use our Products or Services, such as using our apps, visiting our Websites, or reading our emails, we and our partners may use a variety of technologies, including cookies, web beacons, pixels, clear GIFs, log files, embedded scripts, SDKs, location-identifying technologies, or other tracking/recording tools (collectively, "Tracking Technologies"), to collect some of the information described in this section and other information about your activity on our Services, such as links you click, features you use and actions you take within our Services, whether you open emails or click on links in emails from us, ads you view or click on, information about your activity on specific pages of our Websites, such as mouse movements and keystrokes, items browsed and/or placed in your cart, and app performance data.
We may combine this information with other personal information we collect about you.

Messages and Member Content: We collect information when you message other members of your Circle through use of our Services, and any photos or videos you send via the app to other members of your Circles. With your permission, we may also access your photo or camera roll on your mobile device.

Information Provided to Us by Third Parties: We may receive information about you from other sources. If you connect another account to your Life360 account, or sign in to your account using a third-party sign in service, we receive information from the companies providing you these services.

Sign in with Google (and Sign in with Apple). You may also register for or sign in to your Life360 account using your Google account (currently available on Android) or, in the future, your Apple account. If you choose to sign in with Google or Apple, we receive certain information from the identity provider that you authorize through that provider's consent screen. For Google, this includes your unique Google user ID, email address, first name, last name, and, if available, your profile photo.

We use this information to create or locate your Life360 account and pre-fill your profile. We do not receive access to your Gmail, Google Drive, Contacts, or any other Google services. Your phone number and date of birth (where required) are still collected directly by Life360. For information on how Google or Apple handles your data during sign-in, please refer to their respective privacy policies.

For example, we may receive transaction data when you link your accounts through our business partner to enable our subscription tracker feature. Finder Information. If you lose a Tile or your lost pet is wearing a Life360 Pet GPS or Pet Tag and is found by someone who is not a member of your Circle, the finder may scan the QR code on the device and submit a note, and/or location information through a web-based form to help reunite your pet with you, or send you a text/call, as available depending on the product type.
We share this finder-submitted information with you so that you can coordinate the return of your pet. We do not independently verify the identity of individuals who submit this information.

Information We Derive: We may also derive information or draw inferences based on the other information we collect, including precise geolocation data. For example, we may predict that you would be interested in certain offerings or send you certain reminders based on how you have previously interacted with our Services or your typical movement patterns.

HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our Products and Services, to research and develop new products and features, and to promote our Products and Services, as further explained below.

To Provide the Life360 Products and Services: We may use information about you to: Provide the Products and Services to you or other members, including to record the location and movements of you and your devices linked to our Services or to broadcast (sending and receiving) Escaped Pet Mode alerts to your Circle and Lost Pet Alerts to the Pet Finder Network.

Manage your account with us, including authenticating access, verifying identity, and keeping track of your preferences and choices; Personalize your experience on our Services; Ensure the integrity and security, and perform internal quality control and optimization of our Products and Services.

Communicate with you about your account; As stated here, for informational, transactional, marketing and operational purposes, such as account management, customer service, system maintenance, to administer promotional sweepstakes or contests or to remind about items you browsed or left in your shopping cart.

To share your information and/or location with others for certain purposes, such as temporary location sharing or enabling members to connect with you to find their Tiles/Pet Tags/Pet GPS or lost pet.
Provide technical support and repair errors or bugs in our Services; and: To enforce our Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy and comply with our legal requirements.

Marketing Life360 Products and Services: Life360 may use your information for marketing purposes such as to send you emails, text messages, mobile, watch or push notifications, or postal mailings, as allowed by applicable law, with personalized information about Life360’s or our business partners’ products and services including special offers or features that may be of interest to you. Note: Some jurisdictions may require your consent prior to receiving promotional messages. You can opt out of these communications at any time, see below for details.

We may also use the information we collect to understand the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns. With your permission, we may also use information you provide in response to surveys about your experience with our product or services in our marketing materials. This section does not apply to Employee Benefit Program Members.

Research and Development: We may use information we collect in order to: Understand how users engage with our Products and Services, including to monitor which features are popular, metrics, and trends or to contact you to learn more about your experiences; Conduct individual or market research and analytics; Help us to optimally deliver our existing Products and Services.

Connecting with Social Media: When you choose to connect or interact with our Services through a Social Network, or if you use social features, the information provided to Life360 via those Social Networks or social features may be used to verify information that you have independently provided to Life360 and to enhance our ability to provide you with information about our business, products, and Services.

These social features are operated solely by the respective Social Networks, and their service providers, and we recommend that you carefully read their privacy policies before you decide to use them. We have no control over or access to the information collected, stored or used by such Social Networks, and the information practices of such Social Networks are not covered by this Privacy Policy.

ADVERTISING ACTIVITIES: We engage others to provide analytics services, serve advertisements, and perform related activities within our Services and to advertise our Products and Services to you on non-affiliated sites and services. To do this, we use the information we collect about you and your activity on our Services, sometimes combined with other information we receive from third parties.

We also disclose certain information, such as device and advertising identifiers and activity information collected through Tracking Technologies and a hashed version of your email, to advertising partners to select relevant ads to show you on our Services, to deliver advertising targeted to you on other companies' sites or mobile apps, and to understand the effectiveness of advertising.

You have control over our use and disclosure of your personal information for targeted advertising purposes, which you may exercise by navigating to the "Your Privacy Choices " link available in the Privacy section of our settings menu in the mobile app or, with regard to our websites, navigating to the "Your Privacy Choices " link available in the footer of the website.

You can learn more about these controls by visiting these Help Center articles: Limit Information Sharing with Third-Party Partners Through In-App Privacy Settings information page, and To Opt-out of Life360 Sharing Website Data with Third-parties for Advertising Purposes.

This section does not apply to Employee Benefit Program Members. Employee Benefit Program Members are automatically opted out of sharing their personal information with advertising partners and business partners for their own use.
INFORMATION WE DISCLOSE: We or you may disclose your information to different Life360 Services, our subsidiaries, and to third parties for our or their purposes as described below.

Disclosing to Other Life360 Users: Your personal information may be disclosed to other members of your Life360 Circles, including your: full name; email address; cell phone number; precise geolocation data; driving event data; information about your use of our Service with members of your Circles (e.g., whether you have logged in on a new device, or motion activity based on when your device was in use/motion); and

Tiles, Jiobits and/or Life360 Pet GPS trackers and their location (the Tiles may be shared with third parties who are not a member of your Circles upon your request, via the in-app “Unlimited Sharing” setting in the Tile app, which may be modified by you at any time).

In addition, you may choose to disclose certain personal information (such as your name, information about your third-party service subscriptions, and precise geolocation data) to other members of Life360 if you wish to benefit from certain features, or other individuals outside of Life360 if you wish to benefit from certain features, like temporary location sharing.

You and/or members in your Circle may also choose to disclose certain information about a pet profile in your Circle (such as a Pet GPS’s precise geolocation data, the pet’s name, profile picture, breed, color, weight, gender, birthday, or care routines and notes) to other members of Life360 (or certain other individuals outside of Life360) if you wish to benefit from certain features.

Also, be aware that other members of your Circles may disclose personal information you have shared with them. If another user uploads their contact list, and you are in their contact list, we may notify that user that you are a Life360 member. You may opt out of being suggested to people who have your contact information.

Information Posted to our Blogs, Community Forums or Other Public Websites: Any information or content that you voluntarily submit, or post to our Websites or blogs, community forums, or comments you post to our Facebook page (or other social media pages) will automatically be available to the public. We may publicly post your reviews and comments online on our website or mobile app or link your reviews to third-party websites.

We are not responsible for any information you choose to provide on social media pages, or for any content or communications you receive as a result of sharing such information. To request removal of your information from our website or blogs, please contact us at shareyourstory@life360.com.

Service Providers and Advisors: We may disclose your personal information to our vendors and consultants who help us provide our Services or who perform services on our behalf, such as accounting, managerial, technical, email, text, or chat services, marketing, research, or analytic services, fraud prevention, bot detection, web hosting, and to others that provide services or features to our members on our behalf.

Business Partners that Provide Certain Services to You: We may disclose personal information, including contact information and location and movement data (including precise geolocation data), mobile/watch device information (such as information generated by the gyroscope and accelerometer in your device), application analytics (including IP address and device identifiers), technical and analytical data, and driving event data with business partners that provide certain features and services you or your circle elects to use through or in connection with our Products or Services, to the extent that they are available in your country or region.
Some examples of these integrated services offered by our business partners include: Crash Detection and Emergency Dispatch Services; Roadside assistance; Identity theft protection.
Uber account linking; and: Driving analytics services.

Business Partners for Their Own Use: In addition to disclosures of certain personal information for Life360's advertising purposes described above and where permitted by applicable law, we also disclose certain information, including precise geolocation data, movement data, and other information, about your use of our Services to select business partners for their own uses, including to combine with other information to derive insights and analytics and use for their own monetization purposes.

We do not make available your contact information (e.g. your name, email, phone number) for such purposes (but may share hashed versions of them with our partners), unless you have asked us to share with the business partner through our app. You can exercise your preferences with respect to these disclosures by navigating either to "Your Privacy Choices" or to "Trusted Partners" in the Privacy section of your app account settings. Note: Partners listed under "Trusted Partners" have different roles in supporting Life360 features and services.

Where a partner uses Life360 data for its own monetization purposes, you can control that use through "Your Privacy Choices. You may also control such use by disconnecting the applicable partner data feed through "Trusted Partners," though doing so may disable useful product features.

Where permitted by applicable law and consistent with your account settings, Life360 provides certain business partners the right to commercialize aggregated and de-identified data to, for example, help insurers or municipal authorities understand and predict driving behavior at scale, and/or to help retailers make decisions on where to open new locations. You may opt out of the processing of your data for those purposes by navigating to the “Traffic & Retail Insights” option under the Privacy section within your app account settings.
This section does not apply to Employee Benefit Program Members. Employee Benefit Program Members are automatically opted out of sharing with business partners for their own use.

Purchasers and Other Third Parties in Connection with a Business Transaction: We may at any time buy or sell/divest the company, or any portion or combination of its products, services, assets and/or businesses. Personal information such as member names and email addresses, and other member information related to our Services will likely be one of the items transferred in these types of transactions. We may disclose, transfer, or assign such information in the course of corporate divestitures, mergers, acquisitions, bankruptcies, dissolutions, or similar transactions or proceedings.

Law Enforcement, Regulators, and Other Parties for Legal Reasons: We may disclose personal information to third parties (including but not limited to, law enforcement, other government entities, or civil litigants) when required to do so by law or subpoena, or if we determine (in our sole discretion) that disclosure is necessary to: (a) conform to the law, comply with legal process, or investigate, prevent, or take action regarding suspected or actual illegal activities.

(b) to enforce our Terms of Service, this Privacy Policy, to take precautions against liability, to investigate and defend ourselves against any claims or allegations, or to protect the security or integrity of our site; and/or (c) to exercise or protect the rights, property, or personal safety of Life360, our employees, members or others.

YOUR CHOICES ABOUT YOUR INFORMATION: We believe in transparency and providing you with the opportunity to make important decisions about how your information is used, processed, stored and shared as outlined in this Section V (Your Choices about Your Information).

Modifying, Correcting, Accessing, Opting Out, and Deleting Your Information: You may correct or modify your account information or personal information (e.g. name, email address, or phone number), or change your password by logging in to your App, clicking on “Settings” and then “Account” (for Life360) or “Manage Account” (for Tile or Jiobit Apps).

You may request to access or review the information we collect or disclose about you, the categories of sources of such information, the business or commercial purpose for collecting your information, and the categories of third parties with whom we disclose personal information, or request that your information be deleted by submitting a request as described below. Please note that the information provided via the in-app links described in this section does not include technical information.

In the Life360 app, you may: Exercise your right to Opt in or Opt out of Personalized Ads as described above.Employee Benefit Program Members are automatically opted out of sharing their personal information with advertising partners and business partners for their own use.

Exercise your right to Opt in or Opt out of data disclosure with Life360’s business partners for their own commercial purposes as described above. Request to access or delete your personal information by visiting the “Additional Data Rights” page in the Privacy section of your app account settings and selecting “Request Your Personal Information” or “Delete Your Account” to submit your request. If you are a Managed Member, the Manager will need to go to the Manager's account and click "Settings" and then click the managed member's account.

From there, the Manager may click either "Date Rights" or "Delete Account" to submit the request. We will process your request and send a confirmation email. Tile Data in the Life360 app: If you’d like to delete your account and deactivate your Tile, first deactivate your Tile by tapping on your desired Tile that you’d like to deactivate, and then scroll down to “factory reset” and follow the on-screen instructions to restore to factory settings.

Then, you may request deletion of your account by contacting us at privacy@life360.com with your request. Please include your full name, the email address associated with your Account, and the Tiles you want to delete. We will be in touch with next steps. To exercise your other rights related to the Tile, including access rights or certain rights that may be applicable to you under the EU Data Act, please contact us at privacy@life360.com with your request.

In the Tile and Jiobit apps, you may: Tile App: First, deactivate your Tile by tapping on your desired Tile that you’d like to deactivate and then click on “more options”; then scroll to the bottom and click “reset”, and follow the on-screen instructions to restore to factory settings. Second, request deletion of your information through the Tile app by clicking on “Settings,” then “Manage Account,” and finally by clicking on “Delete Account” and following the on-screen instructions.

Jiobit App: Request deletion of your personal information through the Jiobit app by first clicking on “Menu,” then “Account,” then to “Delete Account and Data," and finally click on “Delete Account” and follow the on-screen instructions.

To exercise your other rights related to the Tile, PetGPS, or Jiobit Products and Services, including access rights or certain rights that may be applicable to you under the EU Data Act, please contact us as further described below with your detailed request.

You may also request the access, closure and deletion of your account by contacting us at privacy@life360.com with your request. Please include your full name, the email address associated with your Account, and the service you are using.

Note: Prior to deletion of your Tile account, you may transfer your Tiles to another Tile customer by following the instructions found in our support pages covering the Transfer of a Tile. Tiles may only be transferred from or to active accounts.

For Life360 Pet GPS or Tile customers: If you delete your account or other personal information, the location information associated with active Life360 Pet GPS or Tile Products may still be collected anonymously from other Tile and/or Life360 Community members who are running the app and are within Bluetooth range of your device.

To completely disable this type of information collection we recommend you transfer the Life360 Pet GPS or Tiles prior to account or data deletion, and remove the battery from (if applicable) and/or disable your Products by deactivating the device (if applicable).

Controlling Aggregate Insights: As described above, we provide aggregate information to select business partners for their use to, for example, help insurers or municipal authorities understand and predict driving behavior at scale, and/or to help retailers make decisions on where to open new locations. You may decline having your information aggregated and used for these purposes by navigating in the Life360 app to the “Traffic & Retail Insights” option under the Privacy section within your app account settings. This section does not apply to Employee Benefit Program Members.
Employee Benefit Program Members are automatically opted out of sharing their personal information with business partners for their own use.

Marketing Communications from Life360: As described above, we may send you personalized information about Life360's or our business partners' products and services including special offers or features that may interest you by email, text messages, mobile, watch, or push notification, or postal mailing, as allowed by applicable law. You may opt-out of these marketing communications by following the unsubscribe instructions provided in those communications, and as further set forth below. Note: some jurisdictions may require your consent prior to receiving promotional messages.

Email Opt-Out. You may unsubscribe from receiving future marketing emails from us by clicking on the unsubscribe mechanism included in any marketing email you receive. We will process your request within a reasonable time after receipt and within timeframes required by law.

Text Message Opt-Out.You may unsubscribe from receiving text messages by replying “STOP” “QUIT”, “END”, “REVOKE”, “OPT OUT”, “CANCEL”, or “UNSUBSCRIBE” to any message you receive. We make every effort to promptly process all unsubscribe requests.

Postal Mailings Opt-Out. If you no longer want to receive postal mailing from us you may register with the Do Not Mail service available in your country or contact our customer service team at support@life360.com and ask to be added to our do not mail list.

Mobile/Watch Devices and Push Notifications. You may opt out from receiving mobile/watch or push notifications from us by navigating to the “Settings” menu on your device and clicking “Notification Center” on your mobile (or "Notifications" on your watch), and disabling notifications from Life360. Please note, this will turn off all push notifications you receive from Life360, we recommend leaving your “Critical Alerts” toggled on for your safety.

Please note, if you opt out from receiving marketing communications from us, you may still receive non-marketing messages from us, including, but not limited to, messages from members of your family or friendship group who you invite to a Life360 Circle, messages related to a feature of our Service such as when we detect a significant motor vehicle collision involving a member of your Circle or if you are listed as a member’s emergency contact, messages related to your participation in a survey, and transactional messages such as purchase and billing receipts, renewal notices, and Service updates.

Location and Movement Data Collection and Sharing in the Life360 App: We collect, use, and disclose precise geolocation data, driving event, and movement data as described above. You have many options to control this data collection and sharing activity through the App Settings: Opt out of disclosures of this personal information to advertising and business partners by following the instructions behind the "Your Privacy Choices " link in the Privacy & Security section of your app account settings; Employee Benefit Program Members are automatically opted out of disclosures of this personal information to advertising partners and business partners for their own use. Opt out of disclosures to business partners as described above.

Limit Location Sharing with Your Circle(s); and: Disconnect Location Data and Movement Data in Device Settings. If you no longer want to continue using the Products and/or Services, uninstalling the Life360, Tile, and/or Jiobit app (as applicable), removing the battery from (if applicable) and/or disabling the Products by deactivating the device, and logging out from our Service will also stop us from collecting your location.

Web-Based Personal Information Sales: You may also exercise your opt in and opt out of the use and sharing of your personal information collected from our Websites for purposes of showing targeted advertisements on other online properties by visiting the "Your Privacy Choice" link in the footer of the website and adjust the toggles as applicable.

Please note these settings must be completed for each browser on each device you use and for each of our Websites separately, and will not affect App-based settings. If you clear your cookies or your browser is set to do so, you will have to exercise the choice again.

OUR POLICY TOWARDS CHILDREN & TEENS: Life360 takes special precautions to protect the privacy of our younger members.Our Services are only intended to be used by younger members with significant parental or guardian involvement, and approval where required by applicable law. Life360 does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 or under the minimum age requiring parental consent in each jurisdiction where our Services are offered (“Child” or “Children”) without obtaining the consent of a parent or guardian as required under applicable law.

If Life360 learns that we have inadvertently collected personal information of a child without parental consent as required by law, we will take appropriate steps to delete this information. If you are a parent or guardian and discover that your child has a registered account with our Services or is using our Products without your consent, please alert us immediately by emailing privacy@life360.com.

Setting up a Child Account: If a parent wishes to add a member who is a Child to our Services, we request the parent or guardian provide consent as required by applicable law. The Child will then be able to participate in most aspects of the Life360 Services. In some instances, our Products are intended to be worn and used by Children and pets.

By providing the Products to a Child, you represent and warrant to Life360 that you consent to such Child’s use of our Products and Services and further consent as a parent to enable and permit Life360’s collection and use of the information from the Products and Services used by the Child as stated in this Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service.

Personal Information We Collect about Children and Teens: We take special precautions to collect only as much information as is reasonably necessary for Children and teens to use our Products and Services. We retain personal information of Children and Teens for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our Products and Services as further set forth in Section VII. E of this Privacy Policy.

Information Disclosures about Children and Teens: Life360 may disclose the personal information of Children and Teens to our service providers and our business partners that offer integrated services as described in this Privacy Policy. We do not share or sell personal information of members we know to be under 18, nor do we show ads in Child or Teen accounts. Profile and location information of Children and Teens using the Service may be shared with other members of any Circle they join and Children and Teens may exchange messages with those Circle members.
You are responsible for monitoring your Child or Teen’s account and location-sharing activity through our Products and Services and for blocking or permitting location-sharing features.

Managing your Child’s Account or Information: A parent or legal guardian may have a right to request to review or have deleted their Child’s personal information and may withdraw consent for our Products and Services to collect any further personal information from their Child. Please contact us at privacy@life360.com to request to review and/or delete any personal information we may have collected from your Child, or to withdraw permission for Life360 to collect any additional information from your Child.
We will require the parent or guardian to provide us with sufficient identification before providing access to such personal information, or acting upon such request.
HOW WE PROTECT YOUR INFORMATION: Life360 cares about the security of your information. The actions we take to protect your personal information are described below.

Security: We have implemented appropriate standards to reduce the risk of unauthorized or unlawful access of your personal information. No security system is impenetrable and we cannot absolutely guarantee the security of our systems and your information.

We will never send you unsolicited messages or contact you by phone to request sensitive information, such as your account ID, password, payment, or national ID numbers. Please note that the e-mails and other communications you send to us are not encrypted, and we strongly advise you not to share any sensitive information through these means.

If any information under our control is compromised as a result of a breach of security, we will take reasonable steps to investigate the situation and where appropriate, notify any impacted individuals and take steps in accordance with any applicable laws and regulations.

Accuracy and Confidentiality of Your Email Address and Password: You are responsible for maintaining the secrecy of your password and ensuring the email address associated with your account(s) is accurate. We use your email address to contact you about service updates, changes to our policies, and account activities such as requests for your information. We recommend using a strong password unique to this service. If you believe your account has been compromised, change your password immediately via the applicable app or website.
Life360 is not responsible for information or data transmitted to a third party as a result of a member providing an incorrect phone number or email address.
